name: akbun-editvideo
description: Video editing skills — plan and run DaVinci Resolve travel-vlog edits: cut/stabilize, exposure/white balance, face mosaic with review markers, Gmarket Sans Korean subtitles, audio mix, and validated YouTube 4K delivery

interface.shortDescription: DaVinci Resolve travel-vlog editing: cut, color, mosaic, subtitles, audio, 4K delivery
interface.longDescription: Plans and runs a full DaVinci Resolve edit for speech-free travel vlogs shot on iPhone and Insta360 Luna Ultra. The orchestrator duplicates the timeline first, then runs the specialist skills in order: cut editing and stabilization (travelflow style), scope-based exposure and white balance, soft wide face mosaic with markers for later review, Gmarket Sans Korean subtitles (travelnote style), location/ambience/SFX/BGM mixing, and a validated YouTube 4K render. Every change is logged with clip file name and timecode; original timeline and media are never modified. Cut and subtitle styles are separate skills so other styles can be added later.

iPhone 클립 앞부분 흰 화면 잘라내고 흔들리는 클립만 안정화해줘 (davinciresolve-cut-travelflow)
스코프 보고 클립 사이 노출과 화이트밸런스 맞춰줘 (davinciresolve-exposure-whitebalance)
얼굴 나오는 장면에 약한 모자이크 넣고 내가 나중에 찾을 수 있게 마커 남겨줘 (davinciresolve-face-privacy)
Gmarket Sans로 장소·시간 전달하는 한글 자막과 챕터 마커 넣어줘 (davinciresolve-subtitle-travelnote)
